other_conditions: Must be a woman worker registered under Haryana Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (HBOCWWB).
Must have at least one year of regular membership.
Not eligible if the husband is receiving paternity benefits from any department/board/corporation.
Application must be submitted within one year of delivery.
Birth certificate must be attached with the application.
Benefits are available for up to two children, expandable up to three daughters irrespective of order.
To avail benefits, the worker must have a minimum of 90 days of work experience in the preceding year.
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of ₹36,000 per eligible birth (₹30,000 for motherhood and ₹6,000 for nutritious food).
